
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(microbenchmark)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# Generate synthetic dataset (1 million rows)
n <- 1e6
x <- runif(n, min = 0, max = 100)
```


1. Base R: Loop with standard if - else if - else
```{r}
if_else_loop <- function(vec) {
  res <- character(length(vec))
  for (i in seq_along(vec)) {
    val <- vec[i]
    if (val < 25) {
      res[i] <- "Low"
    } else if (val < 75) {
      res[i] <- "Medium"
    } else {
      res[i] <- "High"
    }
  }
  res
}
```


2. Base R: Vectorized ifelse()
```{r}
base_ifelse <- function(vec) {
  ifelse(vec < 25, "Low",
    ifelse(vec < 75, "Medium", "High")
  )
}
```


3. dplyr: Vectorized if_else()
```{r}
dplyr_if_else <- function(vec) {
  if_else(vec < 25, "Low",
    if_else(vec < 75, "Medium", "High")
  )
}
```


4. dplyr: Vectorized case_when()
```{r}
dplyr_case_when <- function(vec) {
  case_when(
    vec < 25 ~ "Low",
    vec < 75 ~ "Medium",
    TRUE     ~ "High"
  )
}
```


Benchmark Performance
```{r}
bm_results <- microbenchmark(
  if_else_loop     = if_else_loop(x),
  base_ifelse   = base_ifelse(x),
  dplyr_if_else = dplyr_if_else(x),
  dplyr_case_when = dplyr_case_when(x),
  times = 30
)

# Print tabular summary
print(bm_results)

# Visualize results
autoplot(bm_results) +
  labs(
    title = "Performance Comparison: Conditional Logic in R",
    x = "Method",
    y = "Time (milliseconds)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
